From 3a2ad7bd3151cc282f06d18948dfb7a0e1138fb2 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Heiner Kallweit <hkallweit1@gmail.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Dec 2017 20:40:52 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] soc: amlogic: meson-gx-pwrc-vpu: don't print error message on
 probe deferral

The error message may be misleading in case of probe deferral
(happens on my Odroid-C2). Therefore don't print it in this case.

Fixes: 75fcb5ca4b46 "soc: amlogic: add Meson GX VPU Domains driver"
Signed-off-by: Heiner Kallweit <hkallweit1@gmail.com>
Acked-by: Neil Armstrong <narmstrong@baylibre.com>
Signed-off-by: Kevin Hilman <khilman@baylibre.com>

diff --git a/drivers/soc/amlogic/meson-gx-pwrc-vpu.c b/drivers/soc/amlogic/meson-gx-pwrc-vpu.c
index 2bdeebc48901..3adb2f2ecefd 100644
--- a/drivers/soc/amlogic/meson-gx-pwrc-vpu.c
+++ b/drivers/soc/amlogic/meson-gx-pwrc-vpu.c
@@ -184,7 +184,8 @@ static int meson_gx_pwrc_vpu_probe(struct platform_device *pdev)
 
 	rstc = devm_reset_control_array_get(&pdev->dev, false, false);
 	if (IS_ERR(rstc)) {
-		dev_err(&pdev->dev, "failed to get reset lines\n");
+		if (PTR_ERR(rstc) != -EPROBE_DEFER)
+			dev_err(&pdev->dev, "failed to get reset lines\n");
 		return PTR_ERR(rstc);
 	}
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/soc/amlogic/meson-gx-pwrc-vpu.c`**
   - The error handling in the `meson_gx_pwrc_vpu_probe` function was modified. 
   - The original error message "failed to get reset lines" was printed unconditionally when the `devm_reset_control_array_get` function returned an error.
   - The modification introduces a conditional check to only print the error message if the error is not due to probe deferral (i.e., if the error code is not `-EPROBE_DEFER`).

### Relationships

- The change addresses a specific issue where the error message could be misleading during probe deferral situations, particularly noted on the Odroid-C2 platform. 
- By suppressing the error message in the case of probe deferral, the patch improves the clarity of error reporting in the driver, ensuring that developers and users are not misled by unnecessary error logs when the device is simply not ready to be probed at that moment. 
- This modification is part of a broader effort to enhance the robustness and user-friendliness of the driver, as indicated by the fix reference to a previous commit.
